explanation: The equation y²+z²=1 describes a unit circle for every real x, producing a circular cylinder along the x-axis. This is an elliptic cylinder with equal semiaxes, as confirmed by the worked solution.

answers.correct_value: An elliptic cylinder whose axis of symmetry is the $x$-axis
answers.wrong_value: A hyperbolic paraboloid whose axis of symmetry is the $x$-axis
